description.en: Exact Range catalog call spelling, concrete providers, alternate behavior and error-carrier differences at one pinned compiler snapshot; not a complete CPU implementation claim.
description.ko: 고정한 컴파일러 스냅샷에서 Range 카탈로그 호출 표기, 실제 제공자, 대체 동작과 오류 전달 타입 차이를 구분한다. CPU 전체 구현 완료를 뜻하지 않는다.

direct_namespace.validation: Every catalog row was independently compile-checked with basic valid primitive argument types. No audit fixture was executed. Source review distinguishes canonical bindings from related functions and parser name hints; later changes require re-audit.

alternate_validation.boundary: Representative operation signatures across supported primitive widths are type checked; this is not a new exhaustive arithmetic/runtime proof.

sources.role: Actual conversion, parse and Range result/inspection rewrites with builtin identity checks
Concrete numeric/Range operation typing and language iteration
Type-operand hints are not callable provider declarations
Explicit primitive integer overloads and IntegerMathError
Explicit-width endian Slice codecs returning ByteError
Strict type-directed decimal integer parse foundation

records.name: Range.at
records.contract: Ordinal lookup with OutOfBounds instead of None. | O(1) checked arithmetic
records.difference: No concrete public callable provider or exact source wrapper was found; existing descriptor inspection and language iteration do not implement this contract.

records.name: Range.closed
records.contract: Ascending inclusive unit-step range; start > end is empty. Endpoints at T maximum are valid. | O(1)

records.name: Range.collect_vector
records.contract: Materializes all values; validates representable length/allocation size before allocation. | O(n) time and storage
records.difference: No concrete public callable provider or exact source wrapper was found; existing descriptor inspection and language iteration do not implement this contract.

records.name: Range.contains
records.contract: Checks directional bounds and divisibility from start by the step magnitude. | O(1) integer operations
records.difference: No concrete public callable provider or exact source wrapper was found; existing descriptor inspection and language iteration do not implement this contract.

records.name: Range.descending
records.contract: Descending half-open unit-step range; start <= end is empty. Unsigned T is supported. | O(1)

records.name: Range.descending_closed
records.contract: Descending inclusive unit-step range; start < end is empty. | O(1)

records.name: Range.direction
records.contract: Ascending or Descending; direction is not encoded as a potentially overflowing signed step. | O(1)
records.difference: The direction fact is available as bool; no RangeDirection enum or canonical Range.direction function is supplied.

records.name: Range.empty
records.contract: Canonical empty descriptor for integer T; has no first or last element. | O(1)
records.difference: No concrete public callable provider or exact source wrapper was found; existing descriptor inspection and language iteration do not implement this contract.

records.name: Range.end
records.contract: Returns the descriptor end bound; inclusion is queried separately. | O(1)

records.name: Range.equal
records.contract: Descriptor equality of bounds, direction, inclusion and magnitude; not sequence equality. | O(1)
records.difference: No concrete public callable provider or exact source wrapper was found; existing descriptor inspection and language iteration do not implement this contract.

records.name: Range.first
records.contract: First yielded value, or None for empty. | O(1)
records.difference: No concrete public callable provider or exact source wrapper was found; existing descriptor inspection and language iteration do not implement this contract.

records.name: Range.get
records.contract: Zero-based ordinal lookup; None when absent. Does not require total count to fit usize. | O(1) checked arithmetic
records.difference: No concrete public callable provider or exact source wrapper was found; existing descriptor inspection and language iteration do not implement this contract.

records.name: Range.is_empty
records.contract: Determines whether the descriptor yields any value without enumerating it. | O(1)

records.name: Range.is_inclusive
records.contract: Whether the end bound is eligible to be included when reached exactly. | O(1)

records.name: Range.iter
records.contract: Creates an independent cursor; does not allocate or require the full count to fit usize. | O(1) setup; O(1) per item
records.difference: Language range iteration creates an internal independent cursor and preserves the descriptor; no public RangeIterator<T> result or Range.iter call is supplied. Enhanced colon-for does not accept a Range.

records.name: Range.last
records.contract: Last reachable value, which can differ from the inclusive end when the step does not divide the span. | O(1) checked arithmetic
records.difference: No concrete public callable provider or exact source wrapper was found; existing descriptor inspection and language iteration do not implement this contract.

records.name: Range.len
records.contract: Exact element count; CountOverflow if it cannot fit target usize. No wrap or truncation. | O(1) checked arithmetic

records.name: Range.new
records.contract: Ascending half-open unit-step range; start >= end is empty. T is a supported fixed-width integer. | O(1)

records.name: Range.rev_iter
records.contract: Creates a cursor beginning at the last reachable value. | O(1) setup; O(1) per item
records.difference: No concrete public callable provider or exact source wrapper was found; existing descriptor inspection and language iteration do not implement this contract.

records.name: Range.reverse
records.contract: Reverses the finite sequence using its first/last reachable values and opposite direction; never negates an unsigned step. | O(1)
records.difference: No concrete public callable provider or exact source wrapper was found; existing descriptor inspection and language iteration do not implement this contract.

records.name: Range.sequence_equal
records.contract: Compares the represented finite sequences; all empty sequences equal, singleton step differences irrelevant. | O(1) exact descriptor arithmetic
records.difference: No concrete public callable provider or exact source wrapper was found; existing descriptor inspection and language iteration do not implement this contract.

records.name: Range.skip
records.contract: Removes up to count leading yielded values; skipping beyond the end yields empty. | O(1)
records.difference: No concrete public callable provider or exact source wrapper was found; existing descriptor inspection and language iteration do not implement this contract.

records.name: Range.split_at
records.contract: Index must be no greater than cardinality; returns ordinal prefix/suffix without enumeration. | O(1) checked arithmetic
records.difference: No concrete public callable provider or exact source wrapper was found; existing descriptor inspection and language iteration do not implement this contract.

records.name: Range.start
records.contract: Returns the descriptor start bound, including for an empty descriptor. | O(1)

records.name: Range.step_by
records.contract: Positive factor multiplies the existing magnitude; zero or an unrepresentable product is an error even for an empty range. | O(1)
records.difference: No concrete public callable provider or exact source wrapper was found; existing descriptor inspection and language iteration do not implement this contract.

records.name: Range.step_magnitude
records.contract: Same-width unsigned magnitude; always positive for a valid noncanonical descriptor. Canonical empty uses 1. | O(1)

records.name: Range.take
records.contract: Returns a descriptor for at most the first count yielded values; count zero is empty. | O(1)
records.difference: No concrete public callable provider or exact source wrapper was found; existing descriptor inspection and language iteration do not implement this contract.

records.name: Range.to_array
records.contract: Exact count must equal static N; no partial output escapes. Target layout bounds still apply. | O(N) writes
records.difference: No concrete public callable provider or exact source wrapper was found; existing descriptor inspection and language iteration do not implement this contract.

records.name: Range.with_step
records.contract: Zero is InvalidStep; otherwise replaces the positive magnitude and retains bounds/direction. | O(1)

actual_extra_calls.name: Range.step
actual_extra_calls.role: Alias for Range.step_magnitude; not a separate catalog row

actual_extra_calls.name: Range.is_descending
actual_extra_calls.role: Directional inspection; not the RangeDirection-returning catalog method

actual_error_contract.missing_error_variant: Catalog Range.at requires OutOfBounds; current RangeError has no such variant.

first_source_groups: Descriptor equal, first, contains and a clearly named direction enum wrapper based on borrowed inspection.
Ordinal get/at/last with exact unsigned span/product checks; do not require total cardinality to fit usize.
take/skip/reverse/step_by/sequence_equal/split_at only after full-range endpoint and error-carrier rules are implemented.
prerequisites: A source module cannot redeclare the prelude Range type; canonical method extension needs an explicit compiler design, otherwise use documented imported range helpers.
Fixed concrete integer overloads are feasible; exact generic Range.empty<T>() needs a primitive generic arithmetic/typed-zero capability or a closed compiler helper.
Full i128/u128 spans can exceed both usize and u128 cardinality even though get/last are meaningful. Avoid signed end-start and end+1 at maximum.
RangeError.OutOfBounds/other exact domain carriers and public cursor protocol are absent.
defer_until_proven: Public RangeIterator/rev_iter with independent cursor, ownership and fused exhaustion semantics.
collect_vector prechecks usize/layout/allocation size and reports actual allocation errors.
to_array<N> proves exact count and partial-initialization cleanup.
tests: Every i8/u8 descriptor endpoint pair in both directions/inclusion modes plus varied valid magnitudes.
Signed extrema and u128 full-domain cases, cardinality overflow with valid ordinal lookup.
Descriptor lifetime and preserved independent iteration; exact errors instead of trap or wrap.

historical_provenance.boundary: The original canonical Range snapshot remains intact. This refresh does not turn Integer source arithmetic helpers into Range methods.

current_canonical_recheck.conclusion: Canonical Range call acceptance remains 11/29; no new Range source provider or public iterator was added.

current_source_foundations.canonical_spelling_boundary: Explicit import range and range.* calls do not extend the canonical Range namespace. Original canonical probes remain dated evidence.
